fixes.name: PDF export fails — reproduce, root-cause, fix, validate live
fixes.notes: Operator-reported: tapping Export PDF fails. Plan: (a) run exportPdf/doExport code path locally against the REAL live tree (morning, morning/random + its real entry) using the same GitHub-read logic; (b) actually trigger /export all and /export morning on the live bot via Bot API sendMessage from this session; capture the literal error or malformed output. Candidates to check only once a real symptom exists: image embedding via rawUrl fetch; deeply nested/unusual entries; sendDocumentBytes multipart correctness and Telegram's actual rejection reason; whether it's scope-specific (whole notebook vs one topic).
fixes.tested: POST-FIX re-run of the identical harness against the SAME live tree: exportPdf('') -> 12159 bytes header '%PDF-1.7'; exportPdf('morning') -> 10829 bytes '%PDF-1.7'; exportPdf('morning/random') -> 10543 bytes '%PDF-1.7' (real PDFs saved locally and byte-verified). node --check passes on pdf.js. Live-bot sendDocumentBytes path unchanged code-wise and was never the failure point (the exception preceded it).
fixes.concerns: Direct Bot API tap-through of the live bot is not possible from this session (no chat_id discoverable while the webhook is set — getUpdates is disabled under a webhook — and no WEBHOOK_SECRET to inject synthetic updates); per the contract's minimum-evidence clause validation was done by executing the Worker's own exportPdf against real live tree data, capturing literal before/after output. Post-deploy liveness of the new bundle is verified via the deployments API + live GET.
fixes.reproduced_failure_literal: Ran the live Worker's own exportPdf (worker/src/pdf.js, unmodified) against the REAL live tree via the same GitHub Contents-API read path. ALL THREE scopes threw identically: 'Error: Input to `PDFDocument.embedFont` was a custom font, but no `fontkit` instance was found. You must register a `fontkit` instance with `PDFDocument.registerFontkit(...)` before embedding custom fonts.' (FontkitNotRegisteredError, pdf-lib PDFDocument.embedFont, thrown at exportPdf pdf.js:160). Scopes failed: '' (whole notebook), 'morning', 'morning/random'. On the live bot this surfaces as the operator's 'Export fails': callbacks x/X catch it and send '❌ Export failed.', commands.js /export likewise, doExport's status message is left stuck at '⏳ Gathering notes…'.
fixes.root_cause: pdf.js embeds custom TTF fonts (DejaVuSans) via doc.embedFont(bytes, {subset:true}) but never called doc.registerFontkit(fontkit), and '@pdf-lib/fontkit' was not even in worker/package.json dependencies (only pdf-lib). pdf-lib REQUIRES a registered fontkit for custom-font embedding, so exportPdf throws on the very first font embed — before any page is drawn — for every scope, every notebook, regardless of content. Not image-related, not size-related, not Telegram-related: the PDF bytes never existed.
fixes.fix: worker/src/pdf.js: import fontkit from '@pdf-lib/fontkit' + doc.registerFontkit(fontkit) immediately after PDFDocument.create(); worker/package.json: added dependency @pdf-lib/fontkit ^1.1.1 (bundled by wrangler at deploy).

fixes.name: Gemini-dispatched tasks fail or return 'not found' — reproduce, root-cause, fix, validate live
fixes.notes: Operator-reported: 'When I ask AI to do some tasks it fails or says not found.' Concrete prior instance: 'Delete that morning note' -> 'No entries found there.' while a note existed under morning/random (the entry lives one level deeper than the literal 'morning' topic). Reproduction order: (1) natural imprecise reference to real live content via the live bot and/or direct dispatch-path simulation; (2) exact unambiguous reference (literal path / entry id) to isolate resolution-matching vs dispatch-mechanism; (3) at least one other dispatched task type beyond delete (edit, natural-language read). Code-reading hypothesis to confirm/refute with evidence ONLY: classifyAndDispatch resolves intent.path via resolvePath('morning') -> resolves to the EMPTY parent node 'morning' -> handleEntryAction reads morning (zero entries) -> 'No entries found there.' without ever descending into morning/random; handleEntryAction also never searches other nodes when the resolved node is empty, and never searches the whole tree when resolution returns null. Fix must make correctly-referenced live content resolve (descend/search deeper, use entry content + recency as signal, search whole tree before reporting not-found) — NOT weaken 'not found' reporting.
fixes.tested: POST-FIX harness (Worker's own routeFreeText -> classifyAndDispatch against the REAL live tree, REAL Gemini key read from live CODEX_KV, Telegram calls captured): 'Delete that morning note' -> '⚠️ Delete entry 20260904-111139-jh2t from random (morning › random)? _2026-09-04 · 11:11 UTC_ Create a new random note' (was: 'No entries found there.'); 'delete entry 20260904-111139-jh2t from morning/random' -> same correct confirm; 'Delete the note in morning/random that says Create a new random note' -> same correct confirm; 'Read me my morning note' -> '📖 Here it is:' + full read page of morning/random containing entry …jh2t (intermediately reproduced 'Topic not found: morning > random' -> separator fix -> PASS). No live writes were made (edit case deliberately excluded from the harness; delete flows stop at the confirm button).
fixes.concerns: treeListing now reads each node's index.md (one Contents-API GET per node) at classification time — negligible for the current 2-node tree; worth revisiting (cache/preview cap) if the tree grows large. Same session limitation as fix-01 re: direct Bot API tap-through.
fixes.reproduced_failure_literal: Operator case 'Delete that morning note' -> 'No entries found there.': traced by executing the Worker's own classifyAndDispatch/handleEntryAction against the REAL live tree (morning has 0 entries; morning/random holds entry 20260904-111139-jh2t). Pre-fix code path: resolvePath('morning') resolves to the EMPTY parent node 'morning'; handleEntryAction readNode('morning') -> 0 entries -> literal reply 'No entries found there.' — the entry one level deeper is never searched. SECOND defect found during post-fix verification: with the fix in place, 'Read me my morning note' still failed with literal reply 'Topic not found: morning > random' because the classifier emits ' > '-separated paths but resolvePath only splits '/', and read/export/delete_topic/delete_entry never normalized separators.
fixes.root_cause: Two compounding resolution defects in worker/src/gemini.js: (1) handleEntryAction only inspected the single resolved node — no descendant search when that node was empty, no whole-tree search when the path didn't resolve, and no fallback when the entry-pick step missed; (2) classifier-emitted 'a > b' path strings were passed raw to resolvePath (splits on '/' only) so any multi-level natural-language target failed resolution outright.
fixes.fix: gemini.js: (a) treeListing now includes per-node entry counts + previews of the latest 3 entries (content + id suffix) so the dispatcher sees entries below empty parents; (b) classifier prompt now instructs resolving to the DEEPEST node whose entries match the description and to prefer entry-bearing nodes over empty same-named parents; (c) handleEntryAction falls back to descendant search when the resolved node is empty, whole-tree content-scored search when the path doesn't resolve, and content-score/most-recent fallback when the entry-pick misses; (d) every dispatch resolution site normalizes ' > '/'>' to '/' before resolvePath.
